title: Ok for
text: Ok for. Not very sturdy, smaller than it looks in the picture. Assembly was easy. I guess for the price … don’t expect too much . Serves it’s purpose.

product_metadata.title: Homykic Over The Toilet Storage, Bamboo 3-Tier Over-The-Toilet Space Saver Organizer Rack, Stable Freestanding Above Toilet Stand with 3 Hooks for Bathroom, Restroom, Laundry, Espresso
features: UTILIZE LIMITED VERTICAL BATHROOM SPACE - The perfect pick for small bathrooms, a 3-tier freestanding over the toilet storage unit helps keep your toiletries organized without taking up too much floor space, you don't have to bend over to get stuff under the sink anymore.

OVER THE TOILET STORAGE - With the bottom shelf 35.6" from the floor, this 24.8” W * 10.3” D * 66.7” H bathroom shelf organizer fits most standard toilets, easily fits into space behind your toilet. It is a great idea to tidy toilet papers, shampoo, shower gels, towels, hairdryers, and plants. With 3 removable hooks for convenience use.

MULTIFUNCTIONAL ORGANIZER RACK - Clear clutter from your laundry room with this storage shelf, the open area for easy access, you can place daily things at eye level for taking at wills, such as detergent and basket. Or put flowers and plants on the balcony for viewing.
DURABLE & DELICATE - Made with solid bamboo wood designed to last. The durable, smooth finish can well protect you from being scratched. Carefully crafted for universal appeal.

ATTRACTIVE DESIGN - Storage is the basic, and innovative design is the key. It can make your bathroom and even your home unique, it is the perfect combination of modernity and nature. White, espresso, gray and natural colors also match with diverse home decoration with effortless cleaning and maintenance.
STABLE CONSTRUCTION - 2 sets of anti-tilt kits for concerning security, protect the toilet storage shelf from waggle and topple over. Adjustable bottom bar for toilets of different heights.
ASSEMBLY IS A BREEZE - We’ve made the assembly easier with clear instructions, and included tools, so you can set it up with no fuss, even if you're not good at handiwork.

BAMBOO IS BETTER - Not only can it grow 3 to 4 feet a day, but the bamboo is as durable as solid beech or maple wood. It's a very strong kind of wood which is surprising given its gentle and delicate nature. Bamboo can be harvested in 4-5 years, which is more environmentally friendly.

details.Included Components: Anti-tilt accessories, Assembly instructions, Over the toilet storage, Assembly hardware
